values.Description:
Groom To Be Decoration Kit (44 Pieces) - Bachelor Party Set

Create a gold, black and white groom celebration setup for a bachelor party, groom welcome or pre wedding event. This 44 piece decoration kit combines balloons, a Groom To Be foil banner, star shape gold foil balloons, a Groom To Be sash and fringe foil curtain backdrops so the main wall and photo area follow one matching theme.

Use the kit for groom room decoration at home, in a hotel room, banquet hall or party venue. The banner and fringe foil curtains can form the wall backdrop, while the balloons can be arranged around the display with the included arch tape and glue dot strip. The finished setup works as a groom photo booth backdrop as well as a decorated area for group photographs and groom welcome moments.

WHAT YOU GET (44 Pieces)
12 Gold Colour Balloons
12 White Colour Balloons
12 Black Colour Balloons
2 Star Shape Gold Foil Balloons
1 Groom To Be Foil Banner
1 Groom To Be Sash
2 Gold Colour Fringe Foil Curtains
1 Arch Tape
1 Glue Dot Strip

The 12 gold colour balloons, 12 white colour balloons and 12 black colour balloons provide 36 balloons for building the main balloon arrangement. Their three-colour combination can be spread around the banner and backdrop instead of relying on a single-colour display.

The 2 star shape gold foil balloons add a separate foil shape to the balloon setup and can be positioned near the Groom To Be foil banner. The 1 Groom To Be foil banner provides the main celebration wording for the wall display, while the 1 Groom To Be sash is an included wearable item for the groom.

The 2 gold colour fringe foil curtains are intended for the backdrop area and give the wall a reflective foil fringe surface behind the banner and balloons. The included arch tape helps organise the balloons into a curved arrangement. The glue dot strip provides another setup aid for positioning decoration elements where suitable.

KEY FEATURES
44 Piece Pack - Combines the listed decoration items and setup accessories in one kit
Three Balloon Colours - Provides gold white and black balloons for a coordinated groom setup
Groom To Be Foil Banner - Places the celebration wording at the centre of the wall display
Two Fringe Foil Curtains - Creates a foil fringe background for the banner and photo area
Arch Tape and Glue Dot Strip - Helps arrange and position the included decoration pieces

PERFECT FOR
Bachelor Party
Groom Welcome
Pre Wedding Groom Decoration
Groom Room Decoration
Hotel Room Bachelor Decoration
Home Party Decoration for Groom
Banquet Hall Decoration
Groom Photo Booth Backdrop

This groom welcome decoration set is suited to buyers preparing a celebration space without sourcing the main banner, balloons, sash, foil curtains and setup accessories separately. It can be used for a home party where one wall becomes the main display, for hotel room bachelor decoration, or for a banquet hall area reserved for groom photographs and pre wedding activities.

For a groom photo booth backdrop, place the two fringe foil curtains on the background wall and position the Groom To Be foil banner where the wording stays visible. Arrange the gold colour, white colour and black colour balloons around the display with the arch tape, then add the two star shape gold foil balloons as foil accents. The Groom To Be sash can be worn by the groom during the celebration and photographs.

WHY CHOOSE THIS KIT

The pack keeps the main groom decoration elements in one 44 piece set with a black white and gold colour party decor theme. It covers the wall wording, balloon arrangement, foil fringe backdrop, groom sash and the listed setup accessories while keeping every included item easy to identify from the pack list.

Start by fixing the fringe foil curtains and banner, then arrange the balloons with the arch tape and use the glue dot strip where needed.
